newsitem.title: UK: Johnson Matthey up after top-end results.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Matthey up after top-end results.

text.p: Shares in Johnson Matthey Plc rose in pre-market trade on Thursday after the precious metals-to-semiconductor materials group posted yearly profits at the top end of analysts forecasts.
The stock was up 7p at 468-1/2 by 0706 GMT in thin volume of 6,250 shares.
"If there is a cloud over the results, it is that palladium and platinum prices have risen recently and the company hasn't mentioned that in its statement," said one analyst.
"But otherwise the results are at the top end of forecasts and that has lifted the shares."
Pre-tax profit rose six percent to 108.3 million stg in the year ended March 31. Analyst forecasts had mostly been in a range between 105 million stg and 110 million.
Chairman David Davies said the company had achieved further profit growth despite unfavourable conditions in several main markets.

"Looking forward, electronic materials division is well positioned for a good year of growth and catalytic systems division will continue to build on its technological leadership and expand its share of world markets," Davies said.
